name: poka-yoke
description: Mistake-proofing for anything: code, config, a schema, a process, a runbook, a form. Use when someone says "poka-yoke this", "mistake-proof it", "make this harder to get wrong", or runs /poka-yoke with no mode named. Applies Shigeo Shingo's method directly to any subject, and hands off to a specialist mode when one clearly fits. Start here when no other poka-yoke mode obviously applies.
